title: Google Calendar and speed tiers
highlights: Google login lets you pick which services to connect and adds a built-in calendar tool for viewing, creating, updating, and deleting events
Guided Google OAuth app setup that detects existing gcloud credentials, validates generated project IDs, and imports the app automatically
Alt+Up/Down cycles the speed tier between Standard, Fast, and Ultrafast
New /desktop command opens the current session in Jcode Desktop
improvements: MCP tool results and mcp_search output are fitted to token budgets instead of fixed caps, and accept_large_output returns the full result
The mcp list action lists only tool names, and mcp_search ranks name matches first
Todo quality gates share rows instead of taking one line each
fixes: Browser actions target the right browser when several run the bridge extension
Interrupting a coordinator stops the swarm workers it spawned (thanks @SiavZ)
A per-call swarm spawn_mode of auto defers to your configured mode (thanks @SiavZ)
/restart and /reload from a remote client no longer wipe the server's transcript (thanks @SiavZ)
The shared server reloads after an install repoints the link it started from (thanks @SiavZ)
run --json and --ndjson report the local or direct profile instead of openrouter
Fixed swarm plan and status handlers that could stall the server
